name: Almost Lovers
source:
You thought it was love—deep, undeniable, written in the stars. But then, without warning, they disappeared. No answers, no closure. Just echoes of what could have been. Now, you’re left chasing the past, unraveling the truth. Was it fate… or just a beautiful lie?

[From [url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/almost-lovers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你曾以为那就是爱情——深沉、毋庸置疑、命中注定。然而毫无征兆地，对方突然人间蒸发。没有解释，没有告别，只留下本可能拥有的未来在记忆里空洞回响。如今，只剩你独自追寻过往，剥开层层真相。那究竟是宿命……还是一场美丽的谎言？

[摘自[url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/almost-lovers]itch.io[/url]]
